oracle: hand-derived tracer schedules of two uniform streams and a hand-derived parcel path with its trail; d3-scale (square-root width scale, piecewise-linear position along a path, linear trail fade), d3-interpolate (neutral colour band), d3-quadtree (nearest-neighbour spacing of the generalised marks)

streams.comment: 3 m straight up at 0.5 m/s: 6 s of travel, a tracer every 1.5 s, so 4 tracers 0.75 m apart; a streak covers 0.4 s, 0.2 m

1 m at 0.02 m/s: 50 s of travel; at 1:50 the shortest streak is 0.045 m, tracers stay 4 streaks apart, so one every 50*4*0.045/1 = 9 s, 6 tracers (the sixth release falls beyond the end five sixths of the time), 0.18 m apart; a streak is the 0.045 m minimum, not 0.4 s * 0.02 m/s = 0.008 m

pathlines.comment: one parcel path at 20 Hz, x = 0.4 a, y = 1.5 + 0.2 a^2 (a: age in s), now 1.02 s old; trail 0.33 s: tail at age 0.69 s = 4/5 between the samples of 0.65 s and 0.70 s, fade = 1 - ago / 0.33, four opacity steps of 0.9 / 4 by the mean fade of a segment; trail 2 s is longer than the path, so the whole path stays and its first point has the fade 1 - 1.02 / 2

occlusion.comment: a solid ball of 5 cm radius 0.3 m towards the eye of the side elevation from the place the parcel had at the age 0.25 s, (0.1, 1.5125, 0): the samples of 0.20, 0.25 and 0.30 s lie within 2 cm of its axis and are hidden, those of 0, 0.05 and from 0.5 s on lie more than 8 cm beside it and are seen; from above the ball is beside the path
